import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def test_receipts_any_small_bool_faster_than_max():
    n = 1000
    values = np.array([True, False] * 500, dtype=bool)
    groups = np.array(list(range(10)) * 100)
    s = pd.Series(values)
    gb = s.groupby(groups)
    for _ in range(10):
        gb.any()
        gb.max()
    reps = 300
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(reps):
        gb.any()
    t1 = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(reps):
        gb.max()
    t2 = time.perf_counter()
    any_time = (t1 - t0) / reps
    max_time = (t2 - t1) / reps
    assert any_time < 0.8 * max_time

import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def test_receipts_all_small_bool_faster_than_min():
    values = np.array([True, False] * 500, dtype=bool)
    groups = np.array(list(range(10)) * 100)
    s = pd.Series(values)
    gb = s.groupby(groups)
    for _ in range(10):
        gb.all()
        gb.min()
    reps = 300
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(reps):
        gb.all()
    t1 = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(reps):
        gb.min()
    t2 = time.perf_counter()
    all_time = (t1 - t0) / reps
    min_time = (t2 - t1) / reps
    assert all_time < 0.8 * min_time
